summary: Iteration 38 — Enterprise module (Multi-Negozio + Ordini Multi-Fornitore). Backend: 17/17 pytest passed (stores CRUD, orders CRUD, total computation, status transitions, store filter, owner scoping, auth guards, PRO status). Frontend (430x900 mobile): PRO gating verified (anonymous + non-PRO fornaio see paywall; admin sees enterprise-hub), full stores CRUD with active-store logic + picker + persistence after reload, full orders flow (create with datalist supplier, item add/remove, total 21.5 computed, scoping per active store, email/whatsapp/print send with bozza->inviato transition, mark received, delete, persistence). Quick regression on Impara/Community and Maestro tabs OK. Test data cleaned up.

minor.issue: Endpoints only require authentication (current_user), not require_pro. A non-PRO authenticated user could use the Enterprise API directly via curl even though the UI is behind PaywallGate. Feature is advertised as PRO-only — consider server-side blindatura like /api/maestro/vision.
Invalid status values are silently coerced to the previous status instead of returning 422; acceptable but hides client bugs.

issues: Floating FABs (Radio bottom-left, WhatsApp/Parla bottom-right) overlap the paywall CTA text 'Provalo gratis o abbonati per sbloccare tutto' and partially cover the sub-monthly/sub-yearly buttons. Pre-existing app-wide FAB overlap, not specific to Enterprise.
Same FAB overlap over bottom content, mitigated by pb-40 padding; no functional blockage (all clicks worked with normal, non-forced clicks).

action_items: OPTIONAL (security/consistency): add require_pro (or PRO check) to /api/stores and /api/purchase-orders so the Enterprise data API matches the UI PaywallGate.
OPTIONAL (design): raise the paywall CTA/subscription buttons above the floating FABs or hide the Radio/Voice FABs on paywalled screens.
critical_code_review_comments: Enterprise endpoints are correctly owner-scoped and exclude MongoDB _id; total is server-computed (good, client cannot forge it).

OrdersManager.sendEmail uses window.location.href = mailto: — works, but on desktop browsers without a mail handler nothing happens while status still flips to 'inviato'. Consider anchor click + user confirmation.
SUPPLIERS entries have empty email fields, so selecting 'BÄKO' does not autofill order-email (verified expected behaviour, not a bug) — user must type the address; consider a hint in the UI.
StoresManager/OrdersManager sizes are fine (<200 lines each); no DRY or async issues found.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_ stores (TEST_Forno Centro, TEST_Forno Stazione, TEST_Store B) and TEST/BÄKO purchase orders under admin@mikilab.de. DB verified empty of stores/orders afterwards.
test_credentials: admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! (PRO/admin); fornaio@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! (NON-PRO -> correctly sees paywall)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Enterprise hub reachable only from Home card home-section-enterprise (no bottom-nav tab). Login flow via paywall-login -> auth-screen works and returns straight into the enterprise tab. Store picker is a native <select> inside [data-testid=enterprise-store-picker]; use select_option with the store id. Order item row testids use random client ids, read them from div[data-testid^='order-item-']. Stub window.print in add_init_script to avoid headless print dialogs; wa.me opens a popup (api.whatsapp.com). Only 2 console errors, both expected 401s from /api/auth/me while anonymous.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found. Only gap: PRO entitlement for Enterprise is enforced client-side (PaywallGate) but not server-side on /api/stores and /api/purchase-orders.
